entries.name: Butcher
entries.description: Two-storey warm red brick butcher shop with a broad red-and-cream awning and one dark display window; no hanging meats or tiny produce.

entries.name: Hardware shop
entries.description: One-storey pale stone hardware shop with a low slate pitched roof, broad dark window and quiet ochre sign without lettering; no tool racks or plank grids.

entries.name: Florist
entries.description: Small one-storey pale plaster florist with a green pitched roof, broad glass greenhouse annex and two broad muted flower-colour plant clusters; no individual petals.

entries.name: Post office
entries.description: Compact two-storey plaster post office with a simple muted green roof, a broad red entrance panel and one simple red postbox. Normal2.1m door.

entries.name: Bank
entries.description: Wide two-storey stone bank, modest pediment and four broad columns. The columns are3m per storey and the central door is normal2.1m high, not a giant ceremonial door.

entries.name: Hotel
entries.description: Wide four-storey warm brick hotel with repeated normal-scale room window bands and a simple slate mansard roof; no fine dormer grids or tiny railings.

entries.name: Garage
entries.description: Low broad brick garage with three4.2m vehicle bays, a normal2.1m side personnel door, simple slate roof and a compact office wing; no parked vehicles.

entries.name: Barber
entries.description: Tiny one-storey pale stone barber shop with a clean teal pitched roof and large three-colour barber pole beside the normal2.1m door.

entries.name: City workshop
entries.description: A small2x2-tile brick workshop building with two broad roof skylights, one4.2m loading bay, normal2.1m side personnel door and one short chimney. This city workshop is2x2, not a standalone5x5 industry.
